# Web view: click a node to see its changed files and live diff ## What to build In `--web`, clicking **any** node opens one side panel for it, replacing today's `#failure` box, which only opened for failed or retryable nodes. From top to bottom, the panel shows: 1. the node title and status; 2. if the node failed or is retryable: the failure text, AI summary, **Retry** and **Merge** buttons (moved unchanged from `renderFailure`); 3. the file list from `view.changes.files` (path, `+N` / `−M`, and `new` / `deleted` / `binary` badges), with totals; 4. under each file, an expandable unified diff, colored for additions and removals, loaded on demand from `GET /changes/?file=`. The data is already there. Every SSE `state` event (and `GET /state`) carries `graph.nodes[i].view.changes = { files: [{ path, added, deleted, isNew?, isDeleted?, binary? }], total: { added, deleted, files } }`. `GET /changes/?file=` returns `{ path, diff, truncated, binary }`. Also show a small `+N −M` line inside each SVG node. Update the README. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `src/web/page.html` (lines 1–60) — CSS variables (`--panel`, `--ok`, `--bad`, `--muted`, `--faint`, `--accent`) and the existing `#failure` styles. - `src/web/page.html` (lines 61–75) — body layout: `#graph`, `#failure`, `#events`, `#summary`. - `src/web/page.html` (lines 82–90) — globals: `state`, `selected`, `NODE_W = 180, NODE_H = 46`. - `src/web/page.html` (lines 160–197) — `renderGraph`: SVG nodes with `data-node-id`, the `clickable` class. - `src/web/page.html` (lines 199–262) — `onRetry`, `onMerge`, `renderFailure`: move this content into the panel and keep its behavior. - `src/web/page.html` (lines 340–400) — `render(s)` and `main()`: the `#graph` click handler sets `selected` and calls `renderFailure(state)`; the SSE `state` listener calls `render`. - `src/web/web-retry.test.ts` — the retry flow that must keep working. - `README.md` (lines 81–90) — "### The web view" section. - `TESTING.md` (lines 52–80) — manual agent-browser check of the web view. ## Patterns to follow **Plain DOM, no framework, no external scripts.** Mirror the existing helpers: `document.createElement`, `para(cls, text)`, `textContent` (never `innerHTML` with server data, because file paths and diff text are untrusted). **Colors** come from CSS variables, with a dark theme block already present; add new rules next to `#failure`'s. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `src/web/page.html` — structure and CSS - **IMPLEMENT**: replace `
` with `
`. Lay it out as a right-side panel on wide screens (e.g. `body` uses a grid with the graph on the left and the panel at `min(520px, 45vw)`) and stacked under the graph below ~900px. The panel scrolls on its own (`overflow:auto; max-height: calc(100vh -
)`). Add a close button (×) that sets `selected = null`. - **IMPLEMENT** CSS: `.files` list rows; `.add` (`--ok`) / `.del` (`--bad`) counts; `.badge`; `pre.diff` monospace with `white-space: pre` and horizontal scroll; diff lines `.l-add` (light green background), `.l-del` (light red), `.l-hunk` (`--muted`); a selected node gets a thicker accent stroke. - **VALIDATE**: open the page (see the manual check below). ### UPDATE `src/web/page.html` — behavior - **IMPLEMENT**: - All nodes get the `clickable` class (cursor pointer). The `#graph` click handler sets `selected` and calls `renderPanel(state)`; `render(s)` calls `renderPanel(s)` instead of `renderFailure(s)`. - `renderPanel(s)`: hidden when `selected` is null or unknown. Build the header, then the failure section (the current `renderFailure` body, unchanged in behavior; on success `onRetry`/`onMerge` still clear `selected`), then the changes section. - **Keep state across renders**: keep `expanded = new Set()` of open file paths and `diffs = new Map()` (`path → { added, deleted, data }`), and reset both when `selected` changes. **Do not rebuild the panel DOM on every SSE event**; update it in place, keyed by path, so scroll position and open files survive. Simplest approach: rebuild only the file list rows whose `(added, deleted)` changed, and add or remove rows for new or removed paths. - Empty state: `No changes yet` when `view.changes` is missing or has 0 files. - Expanding a file: `fetch("/changes/" + encodeURIComponent(id) + "?file=" + encodeURIComponent(path))`, render each line into the `pre.diff` with a class chosen by its first character (`+` → `l-add`, `-` → `l-del`, `@` → `l-hunk`; skip the `+++`/`---` headers' coloring). `binary` → `Binary file`; `truncated` → note `Diff truncated at 200 KB`. On a fetch error show `Could not load the diff` in that row. - **Live refresh**: when an expanded file's `added`/`deleted` changed in a new snapshot, refetch its diff in the background and swap the `pre` content, keeping `panel.scrollTop`. - **Collapsed by default**: every file starts collapsed. Lockfiles (`package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `bun.lockb`, `Cargo.lock`, `poetry.lock`, `composer.lock`, `Gemfile.lock`, `go.sum`) and files with `added + deleted > 1000` also show a `large` hint and never auto-expand. - SVG node: when `view.changes.total.files > 0`, add a small `+N −M` text at the right of the status line (`x = NODE_W - 10`, `text-anchor: end`), green and red tspans; compact numbers above 999 (`1.2k`). - **GOTCHA**: diff text and paths are untrusted: only `textContent`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run build`, then the manual check. ### UPDATE tests - **IMPLEMENT**: keep `src/web/web-retry.test.ts` passing; if it looks for `#failure` or `renderFailure`, update it to the panel. If `src/web/server.test.ts` checks the page HTML for element ids, update those. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web` ### UPDATE `README.md` - **IMPLEMENT**: in "### The web view", add 2–4 sentences: clicking a node opens a panel with its failure (if any), its changed files with `+/−` counts and their live diffs; diffs load on demand and refresh while the agent works; lockfiles and large files start collapsed; finished nodes keep their final changes. - **VALIDATE**: read it back. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Clicking a running task shows its changed files; the list grows as the agent edits more files, with no page reload. - [ ] Expanding a file shows its colored diff; a large one shows the truncation note; a binary one says so. - [ ] Live updates keep the panel's scroll position and the set of expanded files; an expanded file whose counts changed refreshes its diff. - [ ] Clicking a failed node shows the failure, the summary and Retry/Merge in the same panel, and they still work. - [ ] Any node can be selected; `No changes yet` for a node without changes; × closes the panel. - [ ] No `innerHTML` with server data. - [ ] README "The web view" updated. - [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass. - [ ] Checked by hand in a real browser with agent-browser per `TESTING.md` "Web view (agent-browser)": start a `--web` run, `agent-browser open `, click a node, take a screenshot and **look at it**, expand a file, close the panel. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npx vitest run src/web npm test npm run build # manual: see TESTING.md "Web view (agent-browser)" ```
